One glyph shows the worst state. The row answers "does this need
me?", and one shape in a fixed slot answers it at a glance. Two glyphs
would double the slot and the legend, and a split glyph stops reading
by shape at 20px. CI passing and No CI never lead, because every
open PR also has a review state that ranks above them.

svg.text: PrRow (PhoneList.tsx, .ph-row): unread dot, title (bold when unseen,
2-line clamp), Draft chip, NEW or UPDATED badge, CI pill, status text
(updatedNote · reviewStatus, e.g. "2 commits since you looked · needs
review"), one meta line: repo #number · author · age · +a −d · n files.
IssueRow (.ph-row): dot, title, badge, project StatusChip (hidden for
Backlog), up to 2 label chips plus +N, status text (updatedNote · N
comments), meta: repo #number · author · age.
Activity Row (PhoneActivity.tsx, .ph-arow): dot, PR or issue icon in a
32px ring, title, "N updates" pill, meta "PR · repo #number · event", age
in its own right column. Tap expands the timeline.
Today's bug: the PR meta is one ellipsized line with the age third and
the size last, so a long repo cuts files and size first, then the age.
Clash: .ph-arow is the Activity row in phone-list.css (grid, 72px) and the
action-sheet row in phone-actions.css (flex, 56px, padding 0). main.tsx
imports phone-actions.css later, so its rules win on Activity rows too.
New row: one ListRow component with .ph-lrow, .ph-lrow-glyph,
.ph-lrow-title and .ph-lrow-meta for PR, issue and Activity rows. Activity
drops .ph-arow and .ph-arow-wrap; .ph-arow stays the action-sheet row
only.
PrSummary has no comment count, so the PR trailing count needs a
new server field. Issues already carry commentCount.
Glyph is the project status, named again in the sentence with updatedNote.
Labels lead line 3 as outlined chips, at most 2 plus +N. Comment count pins
right on line 3.
Activity uses the same row: kind icon in the glyph slot, latest event and
update count as the sentence, repo #number on line 3. Line 3 runs short
here, the price of one shared row.
6 · Row anatomy, 2x (unread, then read)
Unread PR, UPDATED · numbers above mark line 1, below mark the lower lines

g.text: CI failing · needs review · 2 commits since you looked

svg.text: Read PR, approved · same row without dot or badge
Unread dot, 9px, in the left gutter. Shape carries unread, not colour.
Title, 15/22 bold, up to 2 lines. Starts at x 32 as today.
NEW or UPDATED, 12px bold, outlined, left of the time.
Relative time, bold 12px, pinned right on line 1.
Status glyph, 16px, leads line 2. Worst of CI and review.
Repo #number, 12px. The #number is bold and never cut.
Status sentence, 13px muted: lead state, other state, updatedNote. Ellipsizes at
the end.
Author chip with person icon. Drops first when space runs out.
Files chip with file icon. Drops after the repo name is cut.
Diff size, pinned right on line 3. Never shrinks or drops.
Comment count, icon and number, at the far right of line 3.
Where each piece of today's data goes
Decisions
Unread dot: kept. Title: kept, bold, 2-line clamp as today. NEW / UPDATED badge: kept, left of the time.
Draft: leads the status sentence ("Draft · no reviews yet · No CI").
CI pill and review status: the glyph shows the worst; the sentence names both.
updatedNote: kept, at the end of the sentence.
Repo #number, author, files: line 3 chips. Size pinned right on line 3. Age moves to line 1, right.
Issue status: glyph plus its name in the sentence. Labels: line 3 chips, 2 plus +N. Comment count: line 3, right.
Activity kind icon, event, N updates, age: kept (event and count in the sentence).
New data: PR comment count.
Layout B stays closest to today. Nothing leaves the row: the glyph is added, the time moves to line 1 and size pins
right. About 6 PR rows fit, as today.
Cost: 92px rows, and a third line that runs short on Activity.
Glyph rule, both layouts: one glyph, worst state wins. Order: CI failing, changes requested, CI running, needs review,
approved. Why is in the legend.
Context drawn plainly: #31 large-title header, #33 Layout A section headers (44px, chevron, sentence-case label,
muted count, hairline above), #32 search pill and filter above the nav.
Frame 3 mixes the three row types under one header to show each worst case side by side.
Sample data only: acme-co/orders-api, acme-dev/tools, acme-dev/platform-integration-tools; authors acme-dev,
build-bot, sam-lee. Greyscale labelled boxes, minimum 12px text.
